title: Hath0r Continuous Training Job Specification and Execution Schema
description: Defines specifications, hyperparameters, execution status, and evaluation metrics for agent and model continuous training jobs.

job_id.description: Unique identifier for the training execution job.

target.description: Target component or model tier for continuous training.

dataset_path.description: Path to curated JSONL training dataset.

dataset_samples.description: Number of training demonstration or preference pairs.

epochs.description: Number of training epochs or optimization cycles.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the training job.

mlflow_run_id.description: Linked MLflow experiment tracking run identifier.

model_artifact_uri.description: Storage URI or path for the trained model weights or compiled adapter.

metrics.description: Training convergence and post-training benchmark evaluation metrics.

parameters.description: Method-specific parameters (e.g. LoRA rank, alpha, temperature).
